external_documentation_basis.claim: NVIDIA documents CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES integer identifiers as system GPU ordinals determined by nvidia-smi and supports exact UUID identifiers.

findings.builder_and_payload: Builder target-only mode recomputed the exact 15-entry frozen hash map and reported no packet created. Focused bundle test asserts every reviewed worker file is embedded; builder stages a private single-script packet and contains no provider-push call.
findings.identity_binding: The worker resolves its single CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES token to exactly one current physical NVML row (numeric token by exact physical index; UUID token by exact UUID), requires UUID/index/used/total fields, persists the binding, and fails closed on absent/ambiguous/incomplete inventory. It never chooses the first NVML row or reuses a prior-session UUID.
findings.recipe_and_inputs: Compared with V9, the plan science block, input-identity block, digest-handoff block, pinned source/archive identities, and reviewed export guards are unchanged. The profile remains raw-only GRU hidden=128, layers=2, dropout=0, seed 3, 3 warmup plus 20 timed batches; fit/checkpoint/prediction/score remain disabled.
findings.resource_safety: Existing physical/CUDA ordering and conservative free/used calculations remain strict. Existing VRAM, process, RSS, host/cgroup headroom, disk, GPU free-memory, and telemetry gates remain intact; only the worker wall cap and provisional reservation are tightened to the allocation values.
findings.same_worker_persistence: The startup UUID is passed to each subsequent active resource snapshot. Snapshots require exactly one row for that UUID; memory-domain validation and the active guard abort if UUID is missing or changes. Startup environment/resource, abort, and phase receipts are persisted before profile work proceeds.

gate_boundary: This approval covers only the exact frozen source map. Static transport review of the assembled packet and fresh provider/quota/resource admission remain required before any provider action. No packet build, provider call, profile, fit, export, or scoring was performed by this reviewer.

independent_validation.resource_boundary: 1 CPU, 1,000,000,000 bytes, 120 seconds for focused checks
independent_validation.review_targets_only: pass; exact map reproduced; no packet created
